plan.title: Reopening a saved draft restores fields

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create screen for the draft.
Set the draft title so it can be found and checked after reopening.
Set the draft's stage configuration to RFQ.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Create the two line items required by the setup.
Populate the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Set a known sheet value that can be compared after reopening.
Confirm the first entered sheet value before saving.
Set a second known sheet value for restoration checking.
Confirm the second entered sheet value before saving.
Commit the draft schedule.
Add the participant required by the setup.
Save the fully configured event as a draft.
Leave the create screen and open the events list.
Navigate to the Drafts tab where the saved event should appear.
Verify the saved draft is listed with the expected title.
Reopen the named draft from the events list.

args.label: Enter the title of the project

steps.note: Verify that the title was restored.
Verify that the saved stage set was restored.
Verify that the pricing template remains applied.
Verify that the line-item badge restored the expected count.
Verify that the pricing sheet rendered from the restored template.
Verify the first saved sheet value after reopening.
Verify the second saved sheet value after reopening.
Verify that the saved schedule duration is visible after reopening.
